critical_code_review_comments: attendance-policy.tsx: preset testID uses lbl.slice(0,5) which yields non-unique keys when 3 presets start with different 5-char prefixes ('Stand', 'Stric', 'Slab '). Works today but a 4th preset starting with same 5 chars would collide. Consider indexed testIDs (ap-lp-preset-{i}) if presets grow.

late-penalty.tsx cfgSummary always prints 'har N late = X din' when mode!='slabs' even when disabled — banner correctly distinguishes ENABLED/DISABLED so it is fine. Consider hiding numeric rule when disabled to reduce noise.
late-penalty.tsx month input has no explicit testID (e.g. lp-month). Tests currently rely on YYYY-MM heuristic — adding testID='lp-month' would harden automation.
